# SIGMA fp - CORRECTED task-ABI heartbeat probe (probe A). No USB.
# Verifies TK-OS cre_tsk/sta_tsk with the CORRECT descriptor (stksz=0x2000 at +16).
# Read HBPROBE.BIN after: [0]=B(0x42) [4]=cre id>=1 [8]=sta ret(0) [12]=WORK [16]=heartbeat>0
# If it freezes: pull battery. Injection = gyro hook 0xC00D0794 (one-shot, self-unhooks).
display monitor 0 1
display colorbar 1 0
ctrl sleep 500
display colorbar 0 0
mem set 0xC00D0794 0xFA046FD7
mem set 0xC072EA00 0xE92D4070
mem set 0xC072EA04 0xE30CC6F9
mem set 0xC072EA08 0xE34CC01E
mem set 0xC072EA0C 0xE12FFF3C
mem set 0xC072EA10 0xE1A04000

mem save \HBPROBE.BIN 0xC072EC00,,0x40
display colorbar 1 0
ctrl sleep 500
display colorbar 0 0
